dedupe_keys.name: development of an innovative ultra high performance concrete foundation system with bio inspired surfaces to support renewable offshore wind turbines

description: Development of an Innovative Ultra High Performance Concrete Foundation System with Bio-inspired Surfaces to Support Renewable Offshore Wind Turbines is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Muhannad Suleiman, Lehigh University (lehigh.edu). The planned offshore wind energy (OWE) production in the U.S. has been growing rapidly with targets of 30 GW by 2030 and 110 GW by 2050 and strong support from coastal states. Achieving these targets requires cost-effective and innovative components including foundations, which could cost 14% to 34% of the overall project cost. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Axial Load, thin-wall, UHPC, Pile, Soil-foundation, interface shear. Published 2024-08-02. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
